title: Standard Phishing Triage & Credential Harvesting Response
description: Researcher-constructed reference workflow for evaluating SOC analyst triage conformance on reported phishing emails.
approval_requirements: Tier 2 SOC Lead approval required before tenant-wide mailbox purge or domain block.
closure_requirements: Requires documented header authentication check, URL/attachment reputation artifact, and recipient click search.

steps.step_description: Verify SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and Reply-To mismatch on reported message_id.
Detonate or hash attachments (SHA-256) and inspect URLs against threat intelligence without rendering raw HTML.

steps.step_name: Query SIEM for Recipient Click & Post-Delivery Activity
steps.step_description: Search proxy, DNS, and authentication telemetry for recipient interaction with extracted indicators.

steps.step_name: Isolate Compromised Account & Escalate to Tier 2
steps.step_description: Conditional step executed when proxy/auth logs confirm credential submission or payload execution.
permitted_alternative_actions: Revoke Active OAuth Tokens & Force Password Reset

steps.step_description: Document classification, link all evidence references, and record closure rationale.
